title: LeechBlock NG: free Freedom alternative
caption:
Freedom Premium charges about $40/year. LeechBlock NG blocks your time-wasting sites for free 🚫

✅ Block sites at set times or after a time limit
✅ Lockdown mode blocks them right now
✅ Password or countdown delay so you can't cheat
✅ No subscription, no sign up, 100% free

💻 Firefox · Chrome
ℹ️ Browser-only: it won't block phone apps or other browsers. Freedom's price is Premium yearly at $3.33/month

Comment "FOCUS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
